remarks: Welcome to 93 Downs Avenue! Located in the idyllic waterfront community of Shippan Point. This absolutely turnkey & captivating home is ready to make a lasting impression. With 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, it's designed with comfort and convenience in mind. Step inside and be greeted by a warm and inviting living space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The classic floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, eat-in kitchen, family room, creating a harmonious flow throughout the home. The kitchen comes equipped with stainless appliances, and a full pantry providing a delightful space for culinary creativity. The primary bedroom is a true retreat. The two additional bedrooms are equally impressive, offering flexibility for use as guest rooms, home offices, or whatever suits your lifestyle. But the charm of this home doesn't stop at the interior. The exterior of this property is equally captivating, with a well-maintained front yard and fenced back yard with a 3-season porch, deck, AND patio. Moments from its own PRIVATE COMMUNITY BEACH. Located in the heart of Shippan Point this home is surrounded by the vibrant community of Stamford moments from parks and a plethora of dining and shopping, there's something for everyone.   This home is more than just a place to live, it's a lifestyle. It's about enjoying the comfort of your own space while being part of a thriving water and beach community. So why wait!
